description: Sample for candidate C of the files in a kernel station's stack that others read or write, id = a short name; would live at $AOS_HOME/lib/tools/aos/kernel/files.json. Paths count from the station's stack, not from the definition folder.

requests.description: the mailbox request letters go to (AOS_KERNEL names this folder)

queue.description: letters waiting for a free slot

decisions.description: write one file per held letter to pass or refuse it; the station acts on it in its next round and deletes it
